_stopping_note: Yang & Jat 2011 SSGA (Algorithm 1) + LS1 (Algorithm 2). pc=0.8, pm=0.5, pop=50 from paper §V (p. 99). C=10^6 HCV weight. Paper uses wall-clock budgets (90s small, 900s medium, 9000s large); the runner only supports FE-budget stopping today — `max_fes` here is sized for medium instances. Override per-tier via CLI: `--functions easy01,... --max-fes 7000` for small, leave default for medium, `--max-fes 70000` for hard/comp16-20.
_data_note: Socha 2002 instances (easy*/medium*/hard*) live in data/socha/ (run scripts/fetch_socha.py). TTC 2002 competition instances (comp*) live in data/ttc2002/ (run scripts/fetch_ttc2002.py).
